integrity.method: reproducible finite exhaustive enumeration with exact Groebner unit-ideal smoothness checks

scientific_limitations: Only geometrically smooth F3 plane quartics with exactly six rational points forming nontrivial blocking sets; existing combinatorial minimum not a new result. Classification of embedded curves over F3, not over closure or higher fields. Equivalent unindexed classifications may exist.
title: Ten projective classes of smooth ternary quartics with extremal nontrivial blocking sets
